cards.title: Old sunlight
cards.text: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth, so you always see the Sun as it was a little over 8 minutes ago.

cards.title: Why ice floats
cards.text: Water expands by about 9% when it freezes. That makes ice less dense than liquid water, so lakes freeze from the top down and fish survive the winter underneath.

cards.title: Packed DNA
cards.text: The DNA in a single human cell would stretch about 2 metres if uncoiled, yet it fits inside a nucleus only a few millionths of a metre across.

cards.title: A very long day
cards.text: Venus spins so slowly that one rotation (243 Earth days) takes longer than its orbit around the Sun (about 225 Earth days). It also spins backwards compared with most planets.

cards.title: Heavy stuff
cards.text: Neutron stars are so dense that a teaspoon of their material would weigh billions of tonnes on Earth.

cards.question: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
cards.explanation: Au comes from the Latin word for gold, aurum. Ag (silver) comes from argentum.

cards.question: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?
cards.explanation: Jupiter's mass is more than twice that of all the other planets combined.

cards.question: Roughly how fast does sound travel through air at room temperature?
cards.explanation: About 343 m/s at 20 °C. 300,000 km/s is the speed of light.

Which of these is a noble gas?

cards.statement: Humans only use 10% of their brains.
cards.explanation: Brain imaging shows activity across virtually the whole brain over the course of a day; there is no idle 90%.

cards.statement: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
cards.explanation: Tall structures get struck repeatedly. The Empire State Building is hit around 20–25 times a year.

cards.statement: The Great Wall of China is visible from the Moon with the naked eye.
cards.explanation: It is far too narrow. Astronauts report it is hard to spot even from low Earth orbit.

cards.statement: Diamonds and pencil graphite are made of the same element.
cards.explanation: Both are pure carbon; only the arrangement of the atoms differs.

cards.statement: Old church windows are thicker at the bottom because glass slowly flows like a liquid.
cards.explanation: Glass is an amorphous solid and does not flow measurably over centuries; old panes were simply uneven when made.

cards.statement: Sound cannot travel through the vacuum of space.
cards.explanation: Sound needs a medium such as air or water to carry its vibrations.
Mars is roughly half Earth's width.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of any metal, which is why it was used in light-bulb filaments.
